history.rating_rationale: Lots to like: sub-$1.25M quantum (deep buyer pool), efficient 775 sqft 2BR (widest tenant base), freehold tenure, and 450m to an EW-line MRT. Strong profile, thin evidence, lands at the top of Neutral.
